_help: Add a channel: copy one object. type = youtube (channelId = YouTube UC... id, plays when that channel is live) | hls (url = .m3u8) | radio (url = mp3/aac stream) | facebook (url = public FB video/live URL) | link (no embeddable stream; shows slate with link). Optional fallback: another source object tried if the first fails. group: local | events. Keep official free sources only. Numbering (cable-style blocks): 1-19 Local News/Gov · 20-49 Culture & Events · 50-69 Faith · 780-799 Radio & Music. cat = news|culture|faith|radio. Blocks: 20-29 Culture & Caribbean · 100s US news · 250s Classic TV (fast) · 300s Sports · 400s Movies (fast) · 500s World news · 511+ Docs/Science · 700s Music video · 780s Radio. type fast = looping playlist from vod.json (q.g genres or q.shows ids).

_meta.note: Existing Dominica/Caribbean + curated free YouTube + validated HTTPS HLS public streams. Ad-supported free-to-air / FAST OK. Official free sources preferred.
